name: Logo wall
description: A wall of cards, one per item (logos, icons, small pictures, each with its label), laid out in a grid that fits however many there are, popping in one after another and then rippling once in the accent colour.

name: Wall zoom
description: A picture full frame breaks into a mosaic wall of all the items, tinted to its colours, then the view zooms into one tile until that picture fills the frame and becomes the next wall: a never-ending gallery.

name: Before / after series
description: A series of before-and-after pairs, items taken two at a time: a divider sweeps each pair from before to after, then the next pair slides or fades in, with a dot for each pair below.

name: Orbit gallery
description: Pictures as cards on a ring in 3D (or a rising helix) that turns a step at a time to bring each to the front, the rest curving away behind it over a faint floor reflection.

name: Split grid reveal
description: A split screen of panels, slanted like a comic page or straight like an editorial grid, each wiping its picture in a beat after the last, then drifting slowly while one panel at a time can take the spotlight.

controls.l: Layout (0 columns, 1 two rows, 2 stacked rows)

name: Filmstrip montage
description: Pictures as frames on a strip of film with sprocket holes, stepping along one frame at a time, each frame in the middle punching in, large, before it moves on.

name: Photo scatter
description: Pictures as white-bordered prints dealt one by one onto a table, landing at scattered angles, then picked up and straightened in the middle one at a time.

name: Bento montage
description: Pictures that fly into a bento grid of rounded tiles, big and small, then step into the spotlight one at a time, lifting with an accent ring while the rest dim.

name: Device morph
description: One screen whose frame morphs from phone to tablet to laptop (or any devices you give it), its screenshot changing to each breakpoint's layout as it grows: a responsive design at a glance.

name: Screenshot carousel
description: One device or browser frame cycling through screenshots, each swapped for the next with a slide, a fade, a zoom or a wipe, the frame floating gently.

controls.l: Frame (0 phone, 1 tablet, 2 laptop, 3 desktop, 4 watch, 5 browser)

name: Device showcase
description: Screenshots on two to five stylised devices (phone, tablet, laptop, monitor, watch, browser) in a staggered layout with depth, drifting in a slow parallax orbit while the devices swap screens one after another.

name: Memphis burst
description: Memphis pop-art shapes spring out from the centre with hard shadows: four-point sparkles, a squiggle, a ring, a triangle and dots, then settle and fade. A flat alternative to confetti.

name: Slop vat
description: A stroked machine vat filling with bubbling slop to how far a job has got, gooey lobes bobbing on the surface and a nozzle dripping into a puddle below.

value.description: How far along the job is, 0–1; null (or left out) while it cannot tell, so the loader plays its own loop.

name: Generating field
description: A soft field brewing over a card while a job runs, its motion set by what is being made, with a glowing front that sweeps across as the job gets further along.

controls.l: Motion (0 image, 1 video, 2 audio, 3 text, 4 vector)

value.description: How far along the job is, 0–1; null (or left out) while it cannot tell, so the loader plays its own loop.

name: Goo drop reveal
description: A flat, ink-stroked blob drops in, splats across the frame and wipes away to the side, leaving its slot revealed with a word in it.

name: Denoise reveal
description: A picture resolving out of noise the way a diffusion model makes it: coarse blotches of colour settle into shapes, then detail, as the grain clears.

name: Change pulse
description: A one-shot highlight on an element that just changed: a ring that blooms out from a new one, a sweep across an edited one, a flash that closes in on a removed one.

name: Agent working border
description: A calm beam of colour gliding round a region's border while an agent works on it, one hue per agent when several work at once.

name: Card complete burst
description: A small burst of sparks and a ring popping from a point on a card's edge when a task is done, sized for a list item rather than a whole screen.

name: Dragover attract
description: A dashed drop zone whose border bulges toward the pointer while something is dragged over it, and ripples out from where the item lands.
